registered: 2026-11-25, before cooling.crossflow_effectiveness was written or run

references.exact: An independent finite-difference solution of the single-pass crossflow exchanger (both fluids unmixed: a 400 x 400 grid marching each stream; one fluid mixed: that stream's temperature uniform across each row), written for this benchmark and sharing no code with cooling.py

published.source: Fan et al., 'Automobile radiator heat transfer analysis' (ASEE 2012, Lamar University), Table 4: crossflow, both fluids unmixed, NTU 0.59, Cr 0.455, effectiveness 40 %

limit_notes: Both-unmixed uses the closed-form approximation (Incropera eq. 11.32); textbooks quote it as accurate to about 1 point of effectiveness, hence 0.01. The one-mixed forms are exact, so their limit allows only for the grid. The published effectiveness is given to two figures.
